name: Holy Cannoli Cold Brew Latte
caffeineNote: Label: "Contains 255mg caffeine", printed below the ingredients, with "Caffeine contents may vary"; the can's own figure supersedes the range Bones publishes on its site
summary: Cannoli-flavored cold brew latte on reduced-fat milk, read off the can at 255 mg of caffeine per 11 fl oz, with 28 g of sugar (16 g of it added, as cane sugar), 8 g of protein and 210 calories. This is Bones' Cold Brew Latte line: their Cannoli Latte is a separate, milder and less sweet can from the flavored-latte line at 200 mg, while the French Toast Cold Brew Latte prints the same 255 mg as this one.
